notes: Exalted: The Abyssals supplied and intake in progress. 175 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/abyssal/inventory/: the character-creation overview, the universal Anima Effect, all five Castes, the Abyssal Curse, the Virtues of Death, the full Resonance mechanic (gain/loss/manipulation), the-title, Useful Crafts, the Cult exclusion sidebar, the six new deathknight-only Backgrounds, the altered Backgrounds, and now 148 Chapter Five Charm rows covering every Ability line for the Dusk, Midnight and Daybreak Castes. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. The Day and Moonshadow Castes' Charm trees, Chapter Six (The Arts of the Dead / necromancy), and Abyssal-specific Merits/Flaws (not yet located) are not yet inventoried; a handful of Chapter Five rows also need a dedicated tree-topology disambiguation pass (see source-manifest.json rulesNotes) before promotion. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
